name: Ogtinc
summary: High above the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara, Ogtinc guides hunters who seek to test their craft against Kalimdor’s fiercest beasts. He left his tribe to serve nature and became a trusted ally and mentor to the Cenarion Circle.

sections.title: A Furbolg Apart
sections.body: Ogtinc camps on a bluff southeast of Timbermaw Hold and keeps watch over Azshara’s shattered lands. He left his kin and gave his bow and knowledge of survival to the Cenarion Circle. Many furbolg remain bound to their tribes, while others fell to corruption after the Third War. Ogtinc chose another path.

sections.title: Master of the Hunt
sections.body: Seasoned trackers know Ogtinc for his knowledge of Kalimdor’s wilderness. He tests hunters who have honed their skills across the continents, sending them after rare trophies: courser antlers, sea serpent scales, and parts of green dragonkin. Through these trials, hunters learn to honor the natural world and preserve its balance, rather than take life without thought.

faq.answer: Ogtinc hunts in Azshara and lends his tracking skills and wisdom to the Cenarion Circle. He left his tribe and camps high on the cliffs.
Ogtinc camps on a cliff in Azshara, overlooking the Ruins of Eldarath, southeast of Timbermaw Hold.

faq.q: Why did Ogtinc leave his tribe?
faq.answer: Ogtinc left his kin to help the Cenarion Circle preserve nature. His tribal origins are not given, and his clear mind and peaceful manner set him apart from the corrupted tribes elsewhere in northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What role does Ogtinc play for hunters?
faq.answer: Ogtinc mentors veteran hunters nearing the height of their training. He sends them after fearsome beasts across Kalimdor, from swift coursers to green dragonkin, to test their mastery of the wild.

faq.q: Is Ogtinc affiliated with Timbermaw Hold?
faq.answer: Ogtinc camps near Timbermaw Hold but works independently with the Cenarion Circle. He is friendly to peaceful travelers, whatever their standing with the Timbermaw tribe.

faq.q: Why does Ogtinc watch over the Ruins of Eldarath?
faq.answer: Ogtinc watches from high above the Ruins of Eldarath, with a clear view of the wilderness below. Naga, elementals, and lingering magical echoes threaten the balance of the coastal forest.

angles.text: As a hunter, you receive spiritual and practical trials from Ogtinc. He tests your marksmanship and survival against Kalimdor’s deadliest creatures.
As a druid, you can look to Ogtinc as a steadfast partner of the Cenarion Circle. He links the wild wisdom of uncorrupted furbolgs with the druids’ care for nature.
